entities.title: Page
entities.summary: The game's HTML page, its styles and the headers Cloudflare serves with it.
entities.purpose: Holds what the build copies unchanged into dist/: index.html with the canvas and the touch buttons under it, hivestorm.css, and _headers with the content security policy.
boundaries: No game script of its own: the build adds game.js from src/main.ts, and the page also loads the games hub's /games/play.js.
build.mjs skips this .dev/ when it copies the folder, so it is never served (games/.dev/decisions.json, publish-dev-files).
